continuity: The World Hunter Federation and allied forces are searching the Middle East for The Prophet; 100,000 Hunters have been deployed, but the search has found no notable leads after its first day, and could take more than sixty days in the worst case.
The Prophet has a large quantity of unrefined Magic Gems and may be preparing a major attack, but Jin suspects they are not ready to carry it out yet.
The Skeleton King and Xiao Shen are investigating the site where a search squad lost contact; the Skeleton King has just spotted something unidentified.
plot: On the flight to the Middle East, Jin Taekyung reviews intelligence on The Prophet and learns the search could take more than sixty days. With The Prophet still holding a huge supply of unrefined Magic Gems, Jin fears a catastrophic attack may be imminent and insists they must find them before they are ready.
Meanwhile, the Skeleton King and Xiao Shen investigate the location where a search squad lost contact. As they arrive, the Skeleton King spots something unexpected.
translation_decisions: Keep magical power distinct from mana.
Preserve the Skeleton King's shift from “Mr. S” to “Mr. King” as a running honorific joke.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung is the World Hunter Federation's Alliance Leader.
The Main Quest [Cataclysm] requires Jin to eliminate The Prophet within an unspecified time limit.
The Prophet is hiding somewhere in the Middle East and possesses a large quantity of unrefined Magic Gems; Jin suspects they are preparing a major attack but are not ready yet.

The World Hunter Federation and allied forces have deployed 100,000 Hunters to search for The Prophet; the search has found no notable leads after its first day, and the worst-case estimate exceeds sixty days.
The Skeleton King and Xiao Shen are investigating a site where a search squad lost contact; the Skeleton King has spotted something unidentified.
open_questions: Can Jin find and eliminate The Prophet before the Main Quest's time limit expires?
What is the unidentified thing the Skeleton King has spotted?
When will The Prophet's attack begin, and what will the Cataclysm involve?
temporary_decisions: Keep magical power distinct from mana.
Do not identify what the Skeleton King spots until it is revealed.
